desc: Ideate the solution strategy (Ascending Sort + DSU).
Implement the solution using the ascending sort + DSU approach.
Ensure tie-breaking in sorting doesn't affect the "strictly smaller" logic (if $A_i == A_{i+1}$, neither absorbs the other, so order doesn't matter for merging, but we must not merge if equal).
Write the final Python code enclosed in the required delimiters.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Test with edge cases (e.g., all elements equal, strictly increasing/decreasing sequences).
Confirm time complexity on a large random test case if possible.
